keyCharacteristics: Mosaic in the frame, never behind text.
Cool porcelain by day, cobalt glaze by night, switched at sunrise and Maghrib for the reader's city.
Eight-pointed tara stars as ayah markers, numbered in Arabic-Indic digits.
Bengali numerals and Bengali UI throughout; Latin only for English and verse references.
Square, tile-cut corners on walls; soft only on controls.

rules.name: The Unglazed Wall Rule
rules.body: Reading surfaces are plain wall colour. No mosaic, gradient, pattern or ad ever sits behind or beside Arabic text.

rules.name: The Glaze Rule
rules.body: State is a change in glaze brightness (cobalt at 10–14% over the wall), never an outline or a border.

rules.name: The Script Numerals Rule
rules.body: Arabic-Indic digits inside Arabic text and on mushaf pages, Bengali digits in the Bengali interface, Latin digits only in English text and verse references.

rules.name: The Two Dials Rule
rules.body: Arabic size and translation size are set separately by the reader (--ar-scale 0.8–1.6, --tr-scale 0.85–1.4).
